input.passage: The Brennick town council voted 7-2 on Tuesday to close Harlow Street to private cars starting in March. Delivery vans will still be allowed between 6 and 10 a.m. The £1.2 million cost of new paving and benches will be covered by a regional regeneration grant rather than local taxes. Shop owners on the street are divided: a bakery owner said more foot traffic would help, while a hardware store owner worried customers would struggle to carry heavy purchases to their cars. The council said it would review the scheme after twelve months.

reference: Brennick's council voted 7-2 to close Harlow Street to private cars from March, allowing deliveries 6-10 a.m. and paying the £1.2 million cost with a regional grant. Shop owners are divided, and the scheme will be reviewed after a year.

input.passage: Researchers at the Aldane Institute report that a coating made from modified chitin, the material in crab shells, kept strawberries fresh for nine days at room temperature, compared with four days for uncoated fruit. The coating is edible and washes off with water. The team tested it on 600 strawberries in three batches. They caution that the coating has not yet been tested on other fruits and that production currently costs about three times as much as existing wax coatings.

reference: An edible, washable chitin-based coating kept strawberries fresh for nine days at room temperature versus four days uncoated, in tests on 600 berries. It is untested on other fruit and currently costs about three times as much as wax coatings.

input.passage: Velto, a maker of electric cargo bikes, said quarterly revenue rose 18% to €42 million, driven by orders from parcel delivery firms. However, the company cut its full-year profit forecast because a battery supplier delay will push about 3,000 bike deliveries into next year. Velto's chief executive said the delay was temporary and that a second supplier would begin shipping in the autumn. Shares fell 6% in early trading.

reference: Velto's quarterly revenue rose 18% to €42 million on parcel-delivery demand, but it cut its profit forecast because a battery supplier delay pushes about 3,000 deliveries into next year. A second supplier starts shipping in autumn, and shares fell 6%.

input.passage: A trial involving 1,200 adults over 65 found that a 20-minute daily balance exercise routine reduced falls by 31% over two years, compared with a group that received only written safety advice. Participants did the exercises at home, guided by a weekly phone call from a physiotherapist. About one in five participants stopped doing the routine within six months. The authors say the results support offering the programme through primary care, but note that the trial did not include people with dementia.

reference: In a two-year trial of 1,200 adults over 65, a 20-minute daily home balance routine with weekly physiotherapist calls cut falls by 31% versus written advice alone, though about one in five quit within six months. The authors back offering it through primary care but note that people with dementia were not included.

input.passage: The open-source database project Quillstore released version 4.0, which replaces its single-threaded write path with a multi-threaded one. Benchmarks published by the maintainers show write throughput roughly tripling on machines with eight or more cores, while read performance is unchanged. The release drops support for the old 2.x file format, so users must run a migration tool before upgrading. The maintainers will continue security fixes for version 3 until the end of next year.

reference: Quillstore 4.0 adds a multi-threaded write path that roughly triples write throughput on machines with eight or more cores while leaving reads unchanged. It drops the 2.x file format, so a migration is required first, and version 3 keeps getting security fixes until the end of next year.

input.passage: The Westmoor community running club will move its Saturday 5 km run from the riverside path to Callan Park from next month, after the council announced six months of flood-defence works on the river. The park route has a short hill, so organisers will add a walking group that starts ten minutes earlier. Entry stays free, and volunteers are still needed for marshalling.

reference: Westmoor running club's free Saturday 5 km run moves from the riverside path to Callan Park next month because of six months of flood-defence works. Because the new route has a hill, a walking group will start ten minutes earlier, and marshalling volunteers are still needed.
